name: kubedesk-plugin-cert-manager
description: cert-manager certificates: when they expire, which are not ready, and the secrets they make
author: Kube Desk

features: A Certificates page: readiness, DNS names, issuer, and when each expires
A card on the overview of certificates not ready or expiring soon
An Expires column in the list of Certificates, and a section in their details
Open a certificate's secret; choose how many days before expiry to warn

scripts.build: bun build src/index.tsx --outfile dist/main.js --format cjs --target browser --external react --external 'react/*' --external react-dom --external kubedesk --production
